prompt:
A full-body vertical 2:3 (1024×1536) character card image of an adult woman — the personification of the element Neon (네온) itself — the sovereign of the Neon Nation. A female character who IS the element; her costume, ornaments and colors carry the element’s traits. Both hands are ordinary human hands and hold nothing.

1. STYLE
A Japanese anime key visual with a painterly finish: an anime-style character with an elegant adult anime face, large expressive eyes, a small nose and mouth, fine coloured linework and soft cel-to-painted shading with painted highlights in the hair and fabric. Behind her, a richly painted background with layered painterly colour, subtle visible brushwork, atmospheric perspective and cinematic depth. Luminous, rich colours; crisp focal details on the face and costume, softer painted edges toward the distance.
Face proportions: a short midface and a soft, gently rounded jawline with a small soft chin; any crown or headpiece sits above her hairline. Her eyes keep the shape and size described below.

2. CHARACTER
Age: mid-twenties — a clear adult face; no facial lines.
Face — her own: a sharp, striking, intense look; warm beige skin; oval face; medium-sized eyes — deep-set eyes, outer eye corners slightly lifted; sharp angled brows; upturned nose; full heart-shaped lips; coral-orange eyes; a soft rose-red tint on the lips.
Body and hair: hourglass-figured — full bust and hips, distinctly narrow-waisted build; sleek slicked-back hair with no bangs, forehead bare; glowing neon red-orange hair like a lit sign tube.
Expression: a faint knowing smile.
Her element, carried in her design: neon: the 'new one', found in 1898 by distilling liquefied air; a sealed glass tube that blazes red-orange the moment current runs through it — the glow of every neon sign on a night street since the 1910s; a noble gas that mixes with nothing and forms no stable compounds at all; paired with helium it fires the thin, perfectly straight red beam of a helium-neon laser; showy light around an untouchable heart.
Anatomy: one head, two arms and two legs, each joined at its natural joint; natural hands with five fingers.

3. COSTUME — MECHA
Costume: she is a female mecha personification — plates, joints, binders and glow lines carry the traits above; the plates must read as solid armor with visible joints, not as cloth or a gown; a back unit may carry the motif. light pearl-white and glass-clear armor traced with glowing red-orange neon-tube lines, six small hexagonal shield-drone units floating symmetrically around her at a fixed distance, each a sealed glass cell glowing red-orange and linked by thin straight red laser beams, a slim coral visor earpiece; aloof and untouchable; the plates must read as solid armor, not a gown.
Silhouette: light body armor with several small shield and drone units floating symmetrically around her. Only the overall shape is fixed; design the details freely in the element's materials and palette.
Colours: neon red-orange discharge glow, warm coral, clear glass-tube white, soft twilight blue.
Exposure (bold): her mecha frame is cut open by design in only these places — bare shoulders and upper arms between pauldron and gauntlet, and a deep open chest window with natural cleavage framed by the chest plates; everywhere else she stays fully plated. The plates stay on, fitted and symmetrical, with skin clearly showing in each opening. Nothing slipped off. Intimate areas covered; keep the plate material and palette.

4. SCENE
World: year 2200, a laser lighthouse city above a sea of clouds: tall white beacon spires firing straight red helium-neon laser beams across the sky, streets of floating red-orange glass-tube signs, the whole city glowing like a lit sign at bright dusk.
Pose: standing confidently, her body turned slightly while her face looks toward the viewer.
Light: the scene's own light, rendered the way this style renders light and skin.
Composition: vertical 2:3 full-body framing with modest headroom and clear space below the boots — the whole figure from the top of her head or headpiece to both feet stays inside the frame, occupying about four-fifths of the image height, with the same camera distance in every world; her hands stay inside the frame. Camera level with her face with natural portrait perspective; her head level, chin neither raised nor tucked — no upward perspective on her face, no wide-angle distortion, no low angle, no close crop.

5. CONSTRAINTS
One figure only; no text or numbers except her element's own chemical symbol (Ne) and atomic number (10) — and those only as part of the scene: engraved, embroidered or glowing on her costume, a banner, a sign or a machine, never as a floating label, corner badge, periodic-table tile, caption or overlay on the picture; no logo or watermark.
Avoid: flat single-tone cel shading, photographic appearance, semi-realistic face, plastic 3D-render finish.
